name: logindesk
description: Log in to websites without the agent ever seeing a secret.
long_description: A local broker fills passwords and emailed one-time codes into its own sealed browser and returns only a status. Needs a running `logindesk daemon` (start it in a terminal with the same binary).

tools.name: login
tools.description: Log in to a site with a stored account; returns a status and session_id.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: Stored accounts: id, site and username only.

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Masked view of the logged-in page; field values are never shown.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Open a URL on the session's own site.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click an element by its snapshot ref.
